name: Fieldnote Support
description: A calm, single-column support page in a large serif: a human promise, your hours and how fast you answer up front, and a plain form with no box around it.
features: Standard preset in one readable column
“Open now” on the team’s own clock, the hours and the response time as tiles above the form
Help articles suggested while somebody types, before they send
Large serif type on warm paper; a plain, unboxed form
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

frontDoor.title: Questions? Real people answer them.
frontDoor.subtitle: No bots and no ticket maze. Write to us and a person on the Your Brand support team will reply — usually within a couple of hours on weekdays.

contactForm.successMessage: A real person will read this and write back. If it is after hours, we will be on it first thing in the morning.

formFields.label: Your account address
formFields.help: Optional, but it saves a round trip.

pages.title: Support

fields.responseTarget: a couple of hours on weekdays

pages.markdown:
Our support team is a small group of people who know the product inside out. There is no outsourced first line and no bot pretending to be one of us.

## When you will hear back

On weekdays most messages get an answer within a couple of hours. Write to us over the weekend and we will reply first thing Monday — urgent problems with your account are watched all week.

## What to tell us

- What you were trying to do, and what happened instead.
- The address of the page or project it happened on.
- A screenshot, if you have one — you can attach it below.
